information:
This is the second installment of Algorithms in Antipolo 2024!!

The base registration fee is Php 400, good for ALL events/puzzles. There is NO refunds under any circumstance. Additional fees will be collected on-site in case the competitor wishes to add an event. For more specific details, check [Payment Details tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AlgorithmsinAntipoloII2024#47914-payment-details).
